label: 儿童式 / 跪姿前趴
pose_lead: Grounded pose, kneeling forward fold (child's pose):
lower_limbs: Both knees bend and the seat settles toward the heels, the legs folded beneath the body.
upper_limbs: Both arms stretch completely forward, palms flat on the ground.
torso_head: The chest and stomach fold down toward the thighs, the head lowering close to the ground.
weight_silhouette: A low, stable weight center; the silhouette descends steadily from the highest point at the hips toward the hands.
